name: Chousen
source:
Chousen is a big, muscular, bald and pigtailed man wearing a thong in contrast of the legendary beautiful woman as in the historical novel. He often shows interest in Kazuto, much to his dismay and disgust.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
